title: Gridmap3D Library "Remove Selected Item" not working
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6 Stable

### System information

Ubuntu Studio Linux

### Issue description

The option to "Remove Selected Item" from a MeshLibrary object does not appear to work, or not appear to work consistently. I've tested this on a variety of libraries and continue to have struggles removing items. Adding times works fine, but the removal does not.

### Steps to reproduce

- Add a Gridmap3D. 
- Add a new Gridmap library object (it can be empty) 
- Click the "MeshLibrary" button in the 3D viewer pane
- Click "Add Item" to add an empty item slot
- Select it, click the "MeshLibrary" button again in the viewer and select "Remove Selected Item"

Nothing happens, Item is not removed.

Add a library of objects, and you can't delete, but you can add items.

This has been inconsistent though, sometimes it does prompt to delete, so something curious is happening under the hood where the removal request isn't consistent but i can't seem to find where or how to make it happily remove.

If you click the item in the bottom selector pane, it never seems to work. If you select the item int he array in the Inspector, sometimes it works. You'll get a second popup to confirm the deletion when it successfully works.

** UPDATE**

Okay, I found if you click an object in the inspector array, and then select within that array object somewhere, such as on it's Name field, and THEN go back to the 3D viewer's MeshLibrary button and select the Remove Selected Object, that works to get the removal prompt properly.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No need for a minimal project. Just open any GridMap3D node and add a MeshLibrary object to the viewer. It can empty since you can add an empty slot right there. It doesn't matter if the library is built out or brand new, the issue persists is for either.
